newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X forms alliance with Indonesian firm.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X forms alliance with Indonesian firm.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd and its sister company, Bro-X Minerals Ltd, said on Monday they had formed a strategic alliance with PT Panutan Duta, a private Indonesian company.
Bre-X and Bro-X said they had retained Panutan as a consultant to assist in administrative, technical and other support matters in Indonesia.
Panutan is a member of the Panutan Group controlled by Sigit Harjojudanto, and has substantial operations in energy resources, mining and telecommunications.
The consulting arrangement is to last for 40 months.
The alliance is outlined in a memorandum of understanding which is subject to Bre-X receiving contracts of work for its Busang properties from the Indonesian government.
In return for its services, Panutan will receive US$1 million per month, Bre-X said.
Panutan will also receive a 10 percent carried interest in Busang I and Busang II, part of Bre-X's rich gold holdings in Kalimantan.
Bre-X, Bro-X and Panutan have also agreed to form a support services company to be owned 60 percent by Bre-X and Bro-X and 40 percent by Panutan.

"We are delighted to have formed an alliance with a strong Indonesian partner," Bre-X chairman David Walsh said in a statement. "This is another major step in the progress towards the expeditious development of our Busang gold project."
